name: ecuador-indicators-desktop
description: Offline-first desktop explorer for Ecuadorian economic and social indicators

scripts.verify:fast: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:e2e: node scripts/prepare-web-fixture.mjs mini && vite build --mode e2e
scripts.e2e:native: node scripts/native-e2e-prereqs.mjs && npx tauri build --no-bundle && npm --prefix e2e-native test
scripts.capture:media: node scripts/prepare-web-fixture.mjs full && vite build --mode capture && playwright test --project=media && uv run --directory pipeline python tools/make_gif.py --frames ../.generated/frames --out ../docs/media/hero.gif --width 960 --duration-ms 900
scripts.verify:ts: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:cov
scripts.verify:rust: cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace
scripts.verify:pipeline: cd pipeline && uv sync --frozen && uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy --strict src tools && uv run lint-imports && uv lock --check
scripts.verify: npm run verify:ts && npm run verify:rust && npm run verify:pipeline && npm run check:bindings && npm run check:data && npm run check:version && npm run build && npm run check:bundle && npm run check:licenses && npm run test:e2e
